notes.title: Fire rework, hold for scroll shop, resizable windows
notes.content:
[tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983041/18a10cc6d23b7fc13d539a39b1e9ddde5a29959c.gif[/img][/td][td]Reworked fire from aoe to dot - now all targets the fireball hits get set on fire, taking damage over time. Damage ticks every 0.15s.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983041/167741518d24bcbdaed22383b1c9d4b4de501523.gif[/img][/td]
[td]You can now click and hold to add levels faster in scroll shop![/td][/tr]


Fixed display issues with 16:10, also made windows resizable.

notes.title: Bug fixes, fire nerf, 1 hour limit
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed damage text display issues beyond 3 numbers, should now display up to 5 numbers or 4 numbers + "K" or "M" for thousand or million
[*]Nerfed fire damage ticks 0.15s>0.25s
[*]When timer hits 1 hour, now spawns a very fast and very strong boss intended to end the game.
[*]Fixed purification zone damage cooldown increasing instead of decreasing
[/list]

notes.title: Leaderboards bug fix
notes.content: Fixed a bug where leaderboards can't be accessed after returning from a match.
